description:
Job Title: IT Recruiter

**Department:** Recruitment  
**Experience:** 3-5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Timing:** 3:30 pm - 10:30pm

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive, target-oriented, and resourceful **IT Recruiter** to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for sourcing, identifying, screening, and engaging suitable candidates for various IT-related roles, including Data Analysts, Business Analysts, Data Engineers, Software Developers, and other technical positions.

The candidate must have hands-on experience using **Naukri and LinkedIn for candidate sourcing**, along with excellent communication, coordination, and follow-up skills. The role requires someone who can understand recruitment requirements, identify the right talent, maintain a strong candidate pipeline, and coordinate effectively with consultants, trainers, and internal teams to ensure smooth recruitment operations.

Key Responsibilities1. Candidate Sourcing & Talent Acquisition

* Source relevant candidates through **Naukri and LinkedIn**, based on the job requirements and skill sets provided by the team.
* Search, identify, and shortlist suitable profiles for various IT and technical positions, particularly Data Analyst, Business Analyst, Data Engineer, Software Developer, and related roles.
* Use advanced search techniques, Boolean search strings, and relevant keywords to identify high-quality candidate profiles.
* Proactively build and maintain a strong database of potential candidates for current and upcoming requirements.
* Explore additional recruitment portals and professional networking platforms to expand the candidate pool.
* Ensure that sourced profiles closely match the required technical skills, experience, qualifications, and job expectations.

2. Candidate Screening & Shortlisting

* Review resumes and assess candidate profiles against the specified job descriptions.
* Conduct initial screening calls to evaluate candidates' experience, technical knowledge, communication skills, availability, and interest in the opportunity.
* Verify essential details such as total experience, relevant experience, current location, notice period, expected salary, and other job-related requirements.
* Shortlist and submit suitable profiles to the concerned consultants or recruitment team for further evaluation.
* Maintain the quality and relevance of submitted profiles while working toward sourcing and recruitment targets.

3. Coordination with Consultants & Trainers

* Coordinate closely with consultants, trainers, and internal stakeholders to understand recruitment requirements and candidate expectations.
* Communicate job requirements, required skill sets, candidate eligibility criteria, and other relevant details accurately.
* Share shortlisted candidate profiles and follow up on feedback, interview schedules, and selection status.
* Coordinate with trainers to understand relevant technical skills, training requirements, and candidate suitability wherever applicable.
* Maintain consistent communication between candidates, consultants, trainers, and the internal team to ensure a smooth recruitment process.
* Track candidate progress and ensure timely follow-ups at every stage of the recruitment cycle.

4. Recruitment Pipeline & Database Management

* Maintain an organized database of sourced, screened, shortlisted, and contacted candidates.
* Track candidate status, follow-ups, interview schedules, feedback, and final outcomes.
* Update recruitment trackers and maintain accurate records of sourcing and screening activities.
* Build and maintain a talent pipeline for recurring IT requirements to improve sourcing efficiency.
* Prepare regular updates on sourcing activities, candidate availability, and recruitment progress.

5. Recruitment Research & Market Awareness

* Stay updated on the latest IT job trends, in-demand technical skills, and candidate availability in the market.
* Understand basic technical terminology and skill requirements for roles such as Data Analyst, SQL Developer, Python Developer, Power BI Developer, Data Engineer, and Business Analyst.
* Identify effective sourcing strategies to find relevant candidates within the required timelines.
* Continuously improve sourcing methods, search techniques, and candidate engagement strategies.

Mandatory Skills & Requirements

* **Hands-on knowledge of Naukri.com and LinkedIn is compulsory.**
* Strong candidate sourcing, resume mining, and profile-shortlisting skills.
* Basic understanding of IT and technical job roles, especially data-related positions.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent coordination and follow-up abilities.
* Ability to understand job descriptions and identify relevant candidate profiles.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple job requirements and candidate pipelines simultaneously.
* A proactive, self-motivated, and target-oriented approach to work.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets for maintaining recruitment trackers and candidate databases.

Preferred Skills

* Experience using additional recruitment portals such as Indeed, Foundit, or other relevant job platforms.
* Familiarity with Boolean search, keyword-based resume searches, and advanced sourcing techniques.
* Exposure to recruitment tracking systems or applicant tracking systems (ATS).
* Previous experience coordinating with technical consultants, trainers, hiring managers, or recruitment teams.
* Basic understanding of technologies and tools such as SQL, Python, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, and related data analytics technologies.

Key Competencies

* **Strong Sourcing Ability:** Capable of finding relevant candidates quickly through multiple channels.
* **Technical Role Understanding:** Able to interpret IT job requirements and identify candidates with matching skills.
* **Communication & Coordination:** Effective in coordinating with candidates, consultants, trainers, and internal teams.
* **Follow-Up & Ownership:** Consistently follows up on candidate responses, feedback, and recruitment progress.
* **Attention to Detail:** Ensures candidate profiles align with the specified requirements before submission.
* **Time Management:** Handles multiple requirements while meeting sourcing deadlines and daily targets.
* **Adaptability:** Learns new technologies, recruitment methods, and sourcing platforms quickly.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic about talent acquisition, comfortable working with recruitment portals, and capable of identifying the right candidates for technical opportunities. The ideal candidate should be resourceful, detail-oriented, and confident in managing candidate sourcing and coordination independently.

A strong understanding of Naukri and LinkedIn, combined with effective communication and a willingness to learn, will be essential for success in this role.

**If you have a passion for recruitment, enjoy connecting with people, and can identify the right talent for IT opportunities, we would love to hear from you!**

Pay: Up to ₹450,000.00 per year

* Client communication and relationship management.

* Fresh graduates from any stream.
* Candidates with excellent communication skills and a positive attitude.
* Individuals who are eager to learn and build a career in HR and Staffing.
* Self-motivated individuals who can work independently in a remote environment.

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office or Google Workspace.
* Strong willingness to learn and take initiative.

**Benefits:**

* Flexible schedule

Our teams take an active part in international infrastructure projects, specializing in bridges, highways, geotechnics, railways, tunnels, foundations ports and maritime structures.

  

### **Job Description**

We are seeking a highly capable Senior Maritime Design Technician to lead the production, coordination and quality of technical drawings for maritime infrastructure projects.

  

The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering clear, accurate and buildable drawing packages that support the planning, design and construction of maritime infrastructure projects across Scotland and the UK.

  

Typical projects include ferry terminals, piers, jetties, quay structures, dolphins, linkspan support structures, slipways, seawalls and associated landside infrastructure such as pavements, drainage and utilities.

  

This role is ideally suited to a practical and detail-oriented technician who takes pride in producing high-quality engineering drawings and understands how those drawings are used by contractors to build infrastructure safely, efficiently and accurately.

  

We are seeking someone who can work proactively with engineers to develop complete, coordinated and construction-ready drawing packages, rather than simply drafting information provided by others. The successful candidate will understand how engineering information should be presented, what drawings are required, what details and annotations are needed, and how to communicate design intent clearly and consistently.

  

Working within a specialist maritime team, the successful candidate will help establish and maintain drawing quality, presentation standards, document control processes and technical consistency across projects.

  

Success in this role will be measured through the quality, clarity and consistency of project deliverables, the efficiency of drawing production, and the ability to support successful project delivery through well-presented and coordinated engineering documentation.

  

### **Job Location**

Noida / Bangalore

  

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the production of technical drawings for maritime and civil engineering projects.
* Develop and maintain complete drawing packages from concept development through to detailed design and construction support.
* Produce clear, accurate and professionally presented civil and structural engineering drawings suitable for construction, procurement and asset management activities.
* Work closely with engineers to develop practical and buildable design solutions and translate engineering concepts into high-quality drawing deliverables.
* Ensure drawings contain the appropriate plans, elevations, sections, details, dimensions, notes and annotations required to communicate design intent effectively.
* Maintain high standards of drawing presentation, consistency and quality across all projects.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary information and ensure drawing packages are fully integrated, technically consistent and ready for issue.
* Manage drawing registers, drawing numbering, revision control, file management and document control processes in accordance with project and business requirements.
* Undertake quality reviews and checking of drawings prior to issue.
* Support the development and maintenance of CAD standards, drawing templates, presentation standards and best-practice procedures.
* Review work outputs and provide guidance, mentoring, and support to junior technicians and CAD team members.
* Promote efficient digital delivery while maintaining a strong focus on practical project requirements and client needs.

### **Candidate Specification**

We are seeking a practical, organised and highly capable technician who is passionate about producing high-quality engineering drawings and takes pride in the presentation, consistency and accuracy of technical deliverables.

  

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong attention to detail, excellent organisational skills and a thorough understanding of how engineering drawings are developed, coordinated and used throughout project delivery and construction.

  

We would encourage you to apply if you are technically strong, intellectually curious and can demonstrate a working knowledge against the criteria below:

  

**Qualifications:**

* HNC, HND, HTQ or equivalent qualification in Civil Engineering, Construction, Engineering Design, CAD or a related discipline.
* Typically 8+ years' relevant experience in the production of engineering drawings for civil, structural or maritime infrastructure projects.
  

**Essential Skills and Experience:**

* Extensive experience producing civil and structural engineering drawings for infrastructure projects.
* Strong technical knowledge of maritime structures, particularly ferry terminal infrastructure, piled jetties, piers, quay structures, dolphins, linkspan support structures, slipways and seawalls.
* Strong knowledge of Revit, Navisworks, and broader BIM tools, including proficiency in AutoCAD and associated engineering drawing production software.
* Demonstrated ability to produce complete, coordinated and construction-ready drawing packages with minimal supervision.
* Strong understanding of engineering drawing principles, technical presentation standards, annotation requirements, drawing composition and construction detailing.
* Experience preparing plans, elevations, sections, details and construction drawings for civil and structural engineering projects.
* Ability to identify missing information, inconsistencies, clashes and coordination issues within engineering deliverables. Demonstrable evidence of information management, clash detection, and model review.
* Experience managing drawing numbering systems, revision control and document management processes including CDE platforms.
* Strong understanding of quality assurance and checking procedures for engineering documentation.
* Excellent attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality and consistent deliverables.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with engineers, technicians and project teams.
* Experience organising, coordinating and managing large drawing packages across multiple projects.
* Strong appreciation of buildability and the requirements of contractors and site teams when preparing construction drawings.
  

**Desirable Competencies / Skills:**

* Engineering Technician (EngTech) registration with a relevant professional institution, or demonstrably close to achieving professional registration, or holding an equivalent professional qualification recognised by the Engineering Council
* Experience working on ferry terminal and harbour infrastructure.
* Experience with BIM-enabled project delivery and information management workflows.
* Experience using Autodesk Civil 3D, Revit, BIM Collaborate Pro or similar platforms.
* Experience supporting condition assessment, asset management and rehabilitation projects.
* Experience complying with CAD standards, drawing templates and quality management procedures.
  

**Flexible working**

* Design the marketing website and landing pages for job seekers, employers and campaigns.
* Build interactive prototypes in Figma to test ideas with the team and real users before development.

* Talk to users, run quick usability tests and use feedback and data to improve designs.
* Work with the Product Manager to turn product requirements into designs, and push back with better ideas when needed.

* 1–3 years of experience as a UI/UX or product designer.

* Strong skills in Figma: components, auto layout, variants and prototyping.
* Good understanding of UX basics: user flows, information architecture, usability and accessibility.
* Experience designing responsive websites and mobile apps that follow Android and iOS guidelines.
* Experience handing off designs to developers and working closely with them.

**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

**1. Role Overview**

AECOM is seeking an 12 years experienced Healthcare Architect/ Planner at **Associate Director** level to lead healthcare planning and design assignments, with a strong track record of delivering large-scale, complex hospital projects, medical colleges and integrated healthcare campuses.

The candidate will be responsible for leading healthcare planning, developing project strategies, managing multidisciplinary design teams and ensuring successful delivery of complex healthcare infrastructure projects from feasibility and programming through concept design, detailed design and construction-stage support.

The role will also play a key part in expanding AECOM's healthcare business in India by leveraging global healthcare expertise, strengthening client relationships and pursuing major opportunities across public and private healthcare sectors.

**2. Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**A. Healthcare Planning & Technical Leadership**

* Lead the planning and design of mega hospitals, tertiary and quaternary care facilities, super-specialty hospitals and integrated healthcare campuses.
* Lead healthcare master planning, clinical planning, functional programming, space planning and departmental layouts.
* Develop comprehensive healthcare planning strategies aligned with international standards, clinical workflows and operational efficiency.
* Demonstrate expertise in planning critical departments, including emergency, OPD, IPD, ICU, OT complexes, diagnostics, radiology, laboratories and specialized clinical facilities.
* Ensure efficient patient, staff, visitor, material and service circulation.
* Integrate medical technology planning, clinical adjacencies, infection control and future expansion requirements.

**B. Project Delivery & Multidisciplinary Coordination**

* Lead end-to-end healthcare planning and design delivery for large and complex projects.
* Coordinate with architecture, structural, MEP, fire and life safety, medical equipment, BIM and specialist healthcare consultants.
* Provide technical direction and quality assurance across all project stages.
* Manage project deliverables, design reviews, technical coordination and client presentations.
* Ensure adherence to project timelines, budgets, quality standards and contractual obligations.
* Lead technical discussions and resolve complex planning and design challenges.

**C. Business Development & Client Engagement**

* Support the growth of AECOM's healthcare business in India.
* Develop and maintain relationships with government healthcare authorities, hospital operators, healthcare institutions, developers and investors.
* Identify and pursue opportunities in mega hospitals, medical colleges, healthcare campuses, greenfield and brownfield hospital developments.
* Lead technical proposals, presentations, feasibility studies and healthcare planning strategies for major bids.
* Contribute to business development, opportunity positioning and strategic client engagement.

**D. International Collaboration & Global Practice Integration**

* Leverage AECOM's global healthcare capabilities, design standards, technical resources and international project experience.
* Collaborate with global healthcare practice leaders and multidisciplinary teams across APAC, Middle East, Europe and other regions.
* Adapt international healthcare planning benchmarks and best practices to Indian regulatory, clinical and operational contexts.
* Facilitate knowledge transfer, technical excellence and innovation across the India healthcare team.

**E. Team Leadership & Practice Development**

* Build, mentor and lead a high-performing healthcare planning and design team.
* Provide technical mentorship to healthcare planners, architects and multidisciplinary specialists.
* Establish healthcare planning standards, design, review protocols and quality benchmarks.
* Promote innovation, digital healthcare planning, BIM integration and technology-enabled design.
* Contribute to the long-term growth and strategic positioning of AECOM's healthcare practice.

**3. Key Project Experience Requirements**

The candidate should demonstrate hands-on leadership and delivery experience in:

* 500–1,000+ bedded multispecialty and super-specialty hospitals.
* Medical colleges are integrated with teaching hospitals.
* Greenfield hospital campuses and healthcare townships.
* Specialized healthcare facilities, including cancer centers, cardiac hospitals, children's hospitals and neurosciences institutes.
* Large-scale healthcare redevelopment and hospital expansion projects.

**4. Qualification & Experience**

* Bachelor's or master’s degree in architecture / urban planning / healthcare planning, Hospital Planning, Healthcare Infrastructure or a related discipline.
* Minimum 15 years of relevant professional experience, with substantial experience in healthcare planning and design.
* Demonstrated experience in independently leading or delivering large-scale hospital and medical college projects.
* Strong understanding of clinical planning, hospital operations, healthcare workflows, functional programming and international healthcare design standards.
* Experience coordinating multidisciplinary design teams and managing senior client stakeholders.
* **International project experience in healthcare planning and design will be a significant advantage.**
* Experience with global healthcare consultancies, international hospital operators or large multidisciplinary engineering and design firms will be preferred.

**5. Desired Competencies**

* Strong technical expertise in hospital and healthcare planning.
* Proven leadership in delivering complex, large-scale healthcare projects.
* Strong client engagement and business development capabilities.
* Excellent multidisciplinary coordination and project delivery skills.
* Understanding of healthcare regulations, accreditation requirements and international planning benchmarks.
* Ability to work across geographies and collaborate with global technical teams.
* Strong commercial awareness, strategic thinking and team leadership.

**6. Key Performance Expectations**

* Successful delivery of major hospital and healthcare campus projects.
* Technical leadership and quality of healthcare planning outputs.
* Contribution to healthcare business development and order-book growth.
* Development of a strong healthcare planning team in India.
* Effective integration of AECOM's global healthcare capabilities.
* Client satisfaction, project performance and delivery excellence.

**7. Reporting & Key Interfaces**

**Reporting to:** U+P Business Leader / Healthcare Practice Leadership

**Expected Outcome**

To strengthen AECOM India's healthcare planning capabilities, providing technical leadership for mega hospital and medical college projects while building a strong pipeline of domestic and international healthcare opportunities.

 **Additional Information**

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

**About AECOM**

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**




**Maintenance Executive (ETP / WWTP)**

**Interested in a career that matters?**

Are you motivated by keeping critical environmental and water-treatment systems running reliably while helping a manufacturing site operate safely and sustainably?

As a Maintenance Executive supporting ETP/WWTP and water-treatment operations, you will play an important role in ensuring reliable plant performance, environmental compliance, efficient water management, and continuous improvement. You will work closely with operations, engineering, quality, EHS and external partners to maintain high standards of safety, compliance and operational excellence.

**The Role & Your Impact**

In this role, you will take ownership of the reliable operation, maintenance and performance of wastewater, sewage and water-treatment systems. You will combine hands-on technical expertise with environmental compliance, equipment reliability, contractor coordination and continuous improvement.

Your key responsibilities will include:

* **Ensure environmental compliance** with MPCB, CPCB and other applicable requirements by coordinating statutory inspections, environmental monitoring, reporting, record keeping and regulatory submissions.
* **Ensure safe and reliable operation and maintenance of WWTP, STP and WTP systems** , including MF, UF, softeners, RO systems, water-storage tanks, pumps, pipelines and associated equipment.
* **Drive equipment reliability** through preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance of pumps, motors, blowers, agitators, valves, filters, instrumentation and pipelines, including root cause analysis and implementation of corrective actions.
* **Manage environmental operations and waste management** , including compliant handling, storage, documentation and disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous waste through authorized agencies.
* **Lead contractors and day-to-day operational execution** by allocating work, monitoring performance and ensuring safe work practices and high operating standards.
* **Monitor and improve plant performance** through water-quality monitoring, chemical-consumption control, environmental KPIs, process optimization, water conservation and technology improvements.

**What You’ll Need to Be Successful**

We are looking for someone with the technical foundation and practical experience to take ownership of environmental and water-treatment operations from day one.

* Bachelor’s degree in **Environmental Engineering, Chemical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering** .
* **8–12 years of relevant experience** in environmental management and water-treatment plant operations and maintenance within a process or manufacturing environment, such as chemical, pharmaceutical, food or FMCG.
* Hands-on experience in **WWTP, STP and WTP operations and maintenance** .
* Strong technical understanding of **RO, UF, MF and softener systems** , along with pumps, motors, valves, pipelines, dosing systems, and water-storage and distribution systems.
* Working knowledge of **MPCB/CPCB environmental requirements** , hazardous and non-hazardous waste management, and environmental monitoring and reporting.
* Experience with **preventive and breakdown maintenance, root cause analysis and equipment reliability** .
* Ability to prepare and maintain SOPs, maintenance documentation and statutory records, and to support regulatory and internal/external audits.
* Professional working proficiency in **English** .
* Strong ownership, analytical problem-solving and prioritization skills, with a safety- and compliance-focused mindset.
Effective communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate contractors, vendors and operational stakeholders.  

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

It would be an advantage if you also bring:

* Experience using **SAP PM or another CMMS** for maintenance planning and documentation.
* Exposure to **ISO 14001** Environmental Management Systems and audits such as ISO, GMP or FSSC.
* Experience supporting **CAPEX projects, automation or equipment-upgrade initiatives** .
* Interest or practical experience in **water conservation, sustainability and process optimization** .
* Experience managing OEMs, laboratories, calibration agencies, environmental consultants or regulatory stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of **Hindi and/or Marathi** for effective shop-floor communication.

**What We Offer**

You will have an opportunity to work in a technically diverse environment where environmental performance, equipment reliability, safety and sustainability come together.

The role provides a broad interface across Production, Quality, EHS, Maintenance, Projects, Supply Chain and Procurement, as well as external regulators, contractors, OEMs, laboratories and environmental partners. You will have opportunities to contribute to continuous improvement, water conservation, automation, equipment upgrades and sustainability initiatives.

This position is based at the **Patalganga MIDC site, near Panvel, Navi Mumbai** .

  

This is a **site-based operational role** supporting critical environmental and water-treatment infrastructure in a process/manufacturing environment.

The position requires close coordination with Production, Quality, EHS, Maintenance, Projects, Supply Chain and Procurement teams, as well as O&M contractors, vendors, laboratories and regulatory authorities.
